world_event: The earth trembles! A great calamity — {name} — stirs upon the horizon, and the cultivators of this realm feel their dantians quiver.
Crows fall silent. The 天劫 (Heavenly Calamity) of {name} has begun its slow approach, and the Dao itself seems to hold its breath.
An ancient warning bell tolls across the realm. {name} is coming, and no mortal wall will hold it back.
The sky bruises purple-black as {name} awakens. Sect elders shout orders; disciples scramble for their finest pills and talismans.
A cold wind carries the smell of iron and old blood. {name} draws nearer — the realm's strongest cultivators are already gathering.
Lightning crawls along the horizon in slow, patient arcs. This is no storm; this is {name}, and it hungers.
Rumors race through the mortal villages: the Heavens have sent {name} to test this realm. The righteous sharpen their swords; the demonic sharpen their schemes.
Deep beneath the sect's spirit vein, something ancient turns over in its sleep. {name} has come to wake it.
The Dao's favored children smile grimly and roll up their sleeves. {name} will not take this realm without a fight.
A lone cultivator stands atop the tallest peak, watching the approaching calamity. 'So,' they murmur, 'the Heaven finally tests us.'
